answer: The farm's sums stop adding up the moment each alias must sit at the bench alone. Paying 81 POA once is a toll; paying it 574 times is a wall, and the wall costs 46494 POA to climb. Trace the ocean to the bench it was made on, the tide to the purse it was paid from, and the signal to the winter it was earned in. I choose Chartered mosaicist grouting file with apprenticeship board confirmation as this epoch's anchor, and the anchor holds because 3-year apprenticeship, 59 supervised mosaics, journeyman exam, guild dues is real.
